capabilities: lock embedded PDFs against scrolling by default
toggle scrolling on and off per embedded PDF via a toolbar button
disambiguation: Only locks PDFs embedded inside notes; it does not control scrolling of PDFs opened standalone.
extras: The manifest carries the warning "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." Installation is manual: download main.js and manifest.json into the vault's .obsidian/plugins folder and reload the app.
intentEvidence: There is no way to prevent the pdf from scrolling, made the bad experience as we are reading our notes
motivation: The author was distracted while reading notes when embedded PDFs scrolled unintentionally, and no existing way existed to prevent that scrolling.
problem: Embedded PDFs shown via syntax like ![[mypdf.pdf#page=34]] scroll unintentionally while reading notes, breaking the reader's focus.
summary: Lock utility that prevents embedded PDFs in notes from scrolling, with a per-PDF toggle button in the toolbar.
